name: rowe
description: An Electron application with React and TypeScript
author: example.com

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.rag:migrate: psql "${RAG_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://$USER@127.0.0.1:5432/rowe}" -f migrations/001_rag.sql && psql "${RAG_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://$USER@127.0.0.1:5432/rowe}" -f migrations/002_users.sql && psql "${RAG_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://$USER@127.0.0.1:5432/rowe}" -f migrations/003_yellow_pages_public.sql
scripts.dev: node scripts/download-snip.mjs && node scripts/download-koffi.mjs && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: node scripts/download-snip.mjs && node scripts/download-koffi.mjs && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.postinstall: electron-builder install-app-deps && node scripts/download-snip.mjs && node scripts/download-koffi.mjs
scripts.build:win: node scripts/download-snip.mjs --all && node scripts/download-koffi.mjs --all && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/download-snip.mjs --all && node scripts/download-koffi.mjs --all && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/download-snip.mjs --all && node scripts/download-koffi.mjs --all && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
